text:
maria: Kicking off planning for the Apr 10 webinar — aim: convert demos -> active users via free credits + tailored prompt templates. Quick sync?

aj: Love it. Metrics we care about: 1) 7-day activation rate, 2) tokens/use per activated user, 3) demo->paid within 30 days. Need tracking plan. @nora can you own instrumentation?

nora: Yep. I’ll add events: webinar_registered, webinar_attended, prompt_template_used, first_successful_completion. Also include utm params on landing page. Will post snippet.

nora: ```js
// example tracking snippet
analytics.track('webinar_attended', {
  utm_source: 'launch_email',
  utm_campaign: 'webinar-apr10'
});
```

sam: For experiments: split 3 arms — A: baseline (generic prompts), B: curated prompt templates (persona-based), C: curated + 50 free credits gated after attendance. Hypothesis: C > B > A on 7-day activation. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: Nice. For copy — short launch post + webinar banner + follow-up email. Draft headlines?

aj: Option 1: "Ship smarter with Redwood's inference playground — free credits for attendees" Option 2: "Faster LLM production: learn the batch/caching tricks" Keep CTA clear: "Reserve your spot — get credits" :thumbsup:

nora: Landing form: checkbox to opt into credits and choose persona (product, data, infra) so we can route leads. Inbound routing rule: persona->nurture track. I’ll add a Webhook to /marketing/inbound with payload example.

nora: ```json
{"event":"webinar_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"product","utm_campaign":"webinar-apr10"}
```

maria: @sam can you create 3 prompt template bundles? small, medium, full. Include quick-start examples for each persona. Deadline EOD Wed.

sam: On it. Also recommend we add a micro-benchmark narrative: show before/after tokens per query and latency improvements with quantization settings. Slide 3 show "cost per 1k tokens" table. Will draft.

aj: Operational note: need a fallback model in routing if dedicated capacity full. @nora pls add flag 'preferred_model' in payload. Also telemetry to track model variant performance.

launch-bot: Event scheduled: webinar-apr10 created. Calendar invite sent to #marketing. Reminders: +1d, +1h.

maria: OK next steps: nemo doc for tracking (assign @nora), prompts (assign @sam), copy (assign @aj). Quick morning sync tomorrow? :coffee:
